reconcile.connective: Defenders keep the verse intact by reading it as a compressed double reference — Abraham's Machpelah purchase and Jacob's Shechem purchase folded into one summary.

discrepancy.connective: The Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the buyer discrepancy at face value: Joshua says Jacob bought the Shechem plot from the sons of Hamor, while Acts 7:16 names Abraham as the buyer of the same sepulchre — both cannot be the same transaction.

skeptic.name: Steve Wells
skeptic.work: Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Who bought the sepulchre in Shechem from the sons of Hamor?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/jacob_bought.html)

excerpts.excerpt_text: Whereas the parcel of ground in Sichem, bought of the sons of Emmor, the father of Sichem, was bought by Jacob, Gen 33:19.… but what best seems to remove the difficulty is, that the words refer to both places and purchases; to the field of Machpelah bought by Abraham, and to the parcel of field is Sichem bought by Jacob, of the sons of Emmor …
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Squarely names the buyer tension (Acts says Abraham bought of the sons of Hamor, but the OT plot at Shechem was bought by Jacob, Gen 33:19) and offers the strongest both-true reading — the verse compresses two distinct purchases/locations (Abraham's Machpelah + Jacob's Shechem) — keeping the text as written rather than emending 'Abraham' to 'Jacob.' Verbatim from the note; two non-adjacent on-tension spans joined by a sense-preserving ellipsis; the first span ends on a real source period, the second is truncated mid-sentence so closes with the elision marker. Gill's own source spelling 'the parcel of field is Sichem' is preserved verbatim.

pd_work.resource: John Gill, Exposition of the Entire Bible (1746-63), on Acts 7:16
pd_work.author: John Gill
pd_work.note: Gill treats this exact buyer pair directly: he states the difficulty (the Shechem sepulchre said in Acts 7:16 to be bought by Abraham, when the OT plot at Shechem was bought by Jacob, Gen 33:19 / Josh 24:32) and harmonizes it as a double reference to both purchases. Used as the PD anchor because Haley's coverage of this specific Joshua 24:32 / Acts 7:16 pair could not be confirmed.
